verdict.rationale: No built-in funnel analytics (pass rates, drop-off, completion time by country or document type) is documented. The VerificationSession API does track each verification from creation through completion, and Stripe emits an event on every status change, so a founder could build a funnel from raw session and webhook data with their own tooling. missing for 10: a first-party analytics dashboard, pass-rate and drop-off reporting, completion-time metrics, breakdowns by country and document type, and any independent corroboration.
